name: respira-urbana-mobile
description: App Android (Capacitor) do Respira Urbana: empacota o client web e fala com o api-gateway.

scripts.setup: npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.run:device: npm run sync && npx cap run android
